stories.story_fr: L'acquisition de RSC Topco (Accession) fait bondir le chiffre d'affaires total de 35,4% au Q1 2026, transformant Brown & Brown en plateforme de courtage elargie, meme si l'organique reste a plat.
stories.story_en: The RSC Topco (Accession) acquisition lifts total revenue 35.4% in Q1 2026, reshaping Brown & Brown into an enlarged brokerage platform even as organic stays flat.
stories.quote: Total revenues of $1.9 billion, increasing $497 million, or 35.4%, compared to the first quarter of the prior year, with flat Organic Revenue and Organic Revenue with Contingents increasing 2.2%

stories.story_fr: Apres 13,8% au Q4 2024, la croissance organique a glisse jusqu'a -2,8% au Q4 2025 puis 0% au Q1 2026, signalant un environnement de croissance difficile pour le courtage hors acquisitions.
stories.story_en: After 13.8% in Q4 2024, organic growth slid to -2.8% in Q4 2025 then 0% in Q1 2026, signalling a tough underlying brokerage growth environment outside acquisitions.
stories.quote: Our teammates continue to deliver for our customers in a challenging growth environment.

stories.story_fr: Les commissions conditionnelles organiques (profit-sharing verse par les assureurs) passent de 43 M$ a 74 M$ sur un an au Q1 2026, dopant la croissance organique avec contingents a 2,2% contre 0% sans.
stories.story_en: Organic contingent commissions (carrier profit-sharing) rose from $43M to $74M year over year in Q1 2026, lifting organic-with-contingents growth to 2.2% versus 0% without.
stories.quote: Organic Contingents $ 74 $ 43 ... Organic Revenue with Contingents growth % 2.2 %

stories.story_fr: Le BPA ajuste dilue progresse de 7,8% a 1,39$ au Q1 2026 et le conseil maintient un dividende trimestriel de 0,165$, soutenu par l'integration des acquisitions.
stories.story_en: Adjusted diluted EPS rose 7.8% to $1.39 in Q1 2026 and the board kept a $0.165 quarterly dividend, supported by acquisition integration.
stories.quote: Diluted Net Income Per Share - Adjusted of $1.39 ... the Board of Directors has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.165 per share
